jsonld.abstract: At UCSB you register for classes in GOLD during your assigned pass times, Pass 1, Pass 2 and Pass 3, each with a unit cap; build a main schedule and a backup before your window opens. Dates to know: the last day to change a Fall 2026 grading option is Friday, December 4 (Letters & Science, checked against the Registrar on October 4, 2026), and Winter 2027 fees are due on your BARC bill by 4 PM on Tuesday, December 15, 2026. Winter 2027 Pass 3 opens Monday, November 30 for graduate students and Tuesday, December 1 for undergraduates, and runs through March 12, 2027 (Registrar, checked November 26, 2026); Spring 2027 pass times had not been published yet.
